mapper.update: TRUNCATE TABLE user_tag_preference; INSERT INTO user_tag_preference(user_id,tag_id,score,update_time) SELECT ua.user_id, atr.tag_id, SUM(CASE ua.action_type WHEN 7 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 3 WHEN 3 THEN 5 WHEN 4 THEN 8 WHEN 5 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS score, NOW() AS update_time FROM user_action ua JOIN article_tag atr ON ua.article_id = atr.article_id WHERE ua.action_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY ua.user_id,atr.tag_id; HAVING score > 0
